tools.name: find
tools.description: Find the capability for a need in plain words, English or Chinese: up to 5, each with its required parameters, price and a ready call. Free, no key. With no match on a named platform it lists all it has: pick from it, or say it is not there. Never use another platform's instead.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: The contract of 1 to 5 capabilities: each parameter with its meaning and values, fields per view, paging, price and the most a call can cost, examples. Free, no key. Use when unsure of a parameter.

tools.name: call
tools.description: One page from one capability, charged per call or per item; errors are free. Give only the parameters `describe` lists for it. The result's first line gives the charge, the balance and how to go on: `cursor` for the next page (charged), `read_more` for the rest of a result cut at 20 KB (free). Needs

tools.name: read_more
tools.description: The rest of a result `call` cut, or it in another view. Free, nothing is fetched again; kept 24 hours. Needs the key that made the call.

tools.name: account
tools.description: balance: balance, key budget and spending. receipt: what one call was charged. usage: calls and charges by day or capability. status: which capabilities are up (no key). Free.
